summary: KT4 on reefer FB-4471 blinks green twice all the time, no data in Tidewalk since Sunday
resolution: Hub KLJ-5-H02 at the Kłaipėda yard had been unplugged by electricians. Plugged back in; tag uploaded about 41 hours of stored readings within 6 minutes.

summary: Humidity stuck at 100 % on 6 tags after wash-down of the container
resolution: Tags were jet-washed at over 80 bar contrary to the guide. Dried 24 h at 40 C in Bay 3; 5 recovered, 1 replaced as goodwill. RMA-2024-01214.

summary: cannot pair new tags, E09 on every try
resolution: Hub SBC-01 still had 250 tags from last season. Released 140 of them in Tidewalk (Devices > Release); pairing works now.

summary: Need calibration certificates for 38 tags before the GDP audit on 22 April
resolution: Certificates sent as one PDF within 24 h (pharma rule). 2 tags were older than 12 months and were recalibrated with the express service (3 working days).

summary: change reporting interval of 40 tags from 10 to 5 min
resolution: Done with Tidewalk bulk edit. Told customer that battery life drops from 38 to 26 months.

summary: Door events arrive late (up to 20 min) on trailer BS-221
resolution: Weak link: tag stores events and uploads them later. Trailer parking moved to row C within 60 m of the hub; events now arrive within 5 s.

summary: Can the KC-Tag 4 be used in our -40 C blast freezer?
resolution: No. Operating range is -35 C to +65 C. Advised not to use below -35 C; no external-probe version exists.

summary: asks for datasheet and CE declaration for a customs filing
resolution: Sent DS-KT4-R2 rev 1.8 and the EU declaration of conformity. HS code is the customer's decision.

summary: Tag KT4-2327-00417 shows +0.3 C off in an ice bath
resolution: Recalibrated in Bay 3 on 18.04.2024: offset 0.28 C at +40.0 C, adjusted. Certificate KCC-2024-00151.

summary: how many KC-Tag 3 trade-in credits do we have?
resolution: Customer returned 112 KC-Tag 3. Credit 112 x EUR 38.00 = EUR 4,256.00 applied to an order of 120 KC-Tag 4.

summary: Tag KT4-2327-00455 reads about 0.8 C low against our reference thermometer
resolution: Bay 3 test on 18.04.2024: offset -0.84 C at 0.0 C, rejected. Board replaced, failed again at -25.0 C (0.91) so scrapped, WF-22 no. 2024-007. Replacement tag shipped the same week.

summary: RTM-3 needs 60 spare KB4-D brackets and 20 bags of KM-2
resolution: Shipped from Gdynia stock on 19 April. Order approved by Hanneke Dijkgraaf.

summary: Excursion alarm: 8.4 C on trailer tag, limit is 8.0 C
resolution: Door had been open for 11 minutes during a border check (driver confirmed). Reported as a non-quality event; customer QA saw no product impact. Tidewalk report attached.

summary: tags report E08 at the Wrocław cross-dock
resolution: Power cut at the site; hub unreachable for 26 hours. Hub restarted, E08 cleared on all tags after the next report.

summary: Integration polling /readings every 5 s gets HTTP 429
resolution: Rate limit is 60 requests per minute per API key on api.tidewalk.korvane.example. Advised to switch to webhooks.

summary: wants humidity calibration for 24 tags
resolution: Humidity points 11.3 % and 75.3 % RH done in Bay 3; 2 tags needed adjustment.

summary: Hub PWR lamp is amber, tags fine
resolution: Amber PWR = running on DC input with no PoE. The switch PoE budget was used up (7 of 8 ports). Moved hub to the PoE injector from the box.

summary: battery life at 2 min interval?
resolution: Answered: 11 months at +5 C, hub at 60 m.

summary: red LED flash every 3 s on one tag
resolution: Sensor fault, error E01 (open circuit). Tag replaced, RMA-2024-01301.

summary: E04 on a brand-new battery after the change in Rotterdam
resolution: Cell was 14 months old (passivation). 1 kΩ load test for 30 s, voltage back above 3.50 V; E04 gone after 2 reports.
Previous calibration 30.03.2023, so older than 13 months. Recalibrated 2024-05-23, certificate KCC-2024-00188, offsets all under 0.10 C.

summary: does firmware 2.8 change validated behaviour?
resolution: Release notes sent. Changes: pairing window 120 -> 180 s, factory reset hold 15 s, OTA battery limits. No change to measurement. Customer decides on revalidation.

summary: OTA to 2.8 failed on 9 tags
resolution: 5 tags below 30 % battery estimate, 4 with a weak link (80 m or more). Hub moved closer, batteries scheduled; campaign rerun OK.

summary: pairing window too short with gloves on
resolution: Known. Firmware 2.8 raises the window to 180 s. OTA planned.

summary: can we use a 2 m antenna extension on the hub?
resolution: ANT-EXT-3 (3 m, loss 0.9 dB) is the approved extension. Others not tested.

summary: tag fell off the door frame at -28 C
resolution: Only the foam tape had been used. Reinstalled with four M4 x 12 screws at 1.2 N·m.

summary: which firmware is current?
resolution: 2.7.0 today; 2.8.0 is released tomorrow (14 May).

summary: authorise Sanne for battery replacement
resolution: Approved on a restricted card (battery and leak test only). Rotterdam PD-25 serial 0412.

summary: single 31 C spike on trailer OD-017, rest normal
resolution: Tag was on 2.6. Spike filter (KCF-1421) arrived with 2.7; OTA scheduled.

summary: Hub FB-H09 CLOUD lamp amber after IT firewall change
resolution: Port 8883 was blocked. Rule added by customer IT.

summary: tag shipped on 14 May is dead again, radio fault
resolution: Unit left Bay 3 without the second functional-test pass. TX power +9 dBm (spec +14 dBm ±1.5 dB); main board MB-4R2-C replaced, full functional test done. Process reminder issued.

summary: customs asks about battery transport papers
resolution: Tag with installed battery travels as a normal parcel with the lithium battery handling mark; no separate declaration.

summary: false door-open events at night on a steel door
resolution: Seal holds the door 10 mm open when 'closed'. Fitted shim set KS-3 (3 x 2 mm) under the magnet.

summary: certificate KCC-2024-00188 not visible in Tidewalk
resolution: PDF attached to the device record, but 2 working days late against the 1-working-day rule. Reminder to Bay 3.

summary: how do we read the tag memory over USB?
resolution: The tag has no USB. Memory is read in Bay 3 with KC-PROG-1, or uploaded through a hub.

summary: quote for 20 ten-packs KT4-R2-868-B10
resolution: Forwarded to Yusuf Demirkıran. List EUR 89.00 per tag excl. VAT, delivery 5 working days.

summary: battery at 14 % after 19 months at 5 min interval
resolution: Cold store at -25 C: 26 months less about 35 % = roughly 17 months. As expected. Replacements planned.

summary: Hub RTM-3-H11 PWR blinking red
resolution: Safe mode after more than 5 restarts in an hour. Damaged PoE cable replaced; cause confirmed with hub status over USB-C.

summary: hub in the rain, ALM lamp red steady
resolution: ALM red = at least one tag in alarm; 3 tags in a warm container. Acknowledged in Tidewalk.

summary: asks for hub range figures
resolution: Tag to hub: 180 m open yard, typically 60 m between steel stacks.

summary: need 30 tags at a 2 min interval for the berry season
resolution: Configured by bulk edit; customer accepts 11 months of battery life.

summary: hub loses NTP time on the customer network
resolution: UDP 123 blocked. Customer allowed it to their internal NTP server; the hub tolerates up to 6 h without time.

summary: E07 on 4 tags
resolution: Clock off by more than 90 s. Tags came in range of the hub, time synced within one interval.

summary: change low-battery warning to 20 %
resolution: Set in the Tidewalk customer profile (standard is 15 %).

summary: magnet fell off the door
resolution: Bag of KM-2 shipped; use screws not just tape.

summary: 140 alarm e-mails overnight
resolution: Notification rule changed to a digest every 30 minutes; alarms still go to SMS.

summary: where do we send RMA tags?
resolution: RMA-2024-01766 issued. Goods receipt Gdynia open Mon-Fri 07:30-15:30.

summary: Tidewalk shows tag offline although LED is green
resolution: One green flash every 5 s = hub in contact; device mapping in Tidewalk was wrong. Fixed.

summary: trailer OD-231: product above 8.0 C for about 9 hours and nobody saw it
resolution: Incident INC-2024-0614 (the Oakhaven incident). Hub OD-H02 had been rebooting for about 3 h and the alarm was sent only once. Escalated to Benedikta Aaltonen and Jarek Lindqvist. Findings fed into firmware 2.9.

summary: wants all alarms of 13-14 June for the whole fleet
resolution: Export for 212 tags delivered; 6 tags had no hub link, none a sensor fault.

summary: which tags are on firmware below 2.6?
resolution: 37 of 920 tags. OTA campaign scheduled in Fleet > Firmware campaigns.

summary: OTA campaign stuck with 20 tags queued
resolution: At most 20 tags per hub at a time, about 11 min each. Normal.

summary: is a tag firmware update a change-control event?
resolution: Yes. Change notification form sent; customer decides about revalidation.

summary: tag blinks fast green forever
resolution: Pairing mode with the hub off. On firmware 2.8 it times out after 180 s; on 2.6 hold the button 10 s to restart.

summary: humidity only 28 % in a sealed container, is the tag broken?
resolution: No. Accuracy is ±3 % RH between 20 and 80 % RH.

summary: is there a Finnish quick start guide?
resolution: No. Guides exist in PL, DE and EN; the next revision (Rev E) will be translated.

summary: torque for bracket screws?
resolution: 1.2 N·m, maximum 1.5 N·m.

summary: 200 tags held at customs, value declaration needed
resolution: Invoice value EUR 17,800.00 (200 x EUR 89.00). Released next day.

summary: humidity of KT4-2340-00934 is off by 5.4 % RH
resolution: Rejected in Bay 3 on 2024-06-27 at 75.3 % RH; board replaced, certificate KCC-2024-00243.

summary: door-open event missing on KT4-2327-00403
resolution: Magnet gap was 11 mm with the door closed (needs 3-8 mm). Magnet moved, events OK.

summary: hub on a 12 m pole, any rules?
resolution: Mount between 3.0 m and 8 m only; 12 m is out of range for PoE and service. Company work-at-height rules apply.
